faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Senior Project Assistant post at AIIMS Bilaspur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Senior Project Assistant position at AIIMS Bilaspur is 21 August 2026. Ensure you apply before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Three Years Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized University to be eligible for the Senior Project Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Senior Project Assistant position is between 18 years and 30 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the notification, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Project Assistant post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,600 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Project Assistant post in this recruitment drive by AIIMS Bilaspur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the Senior Project Assistant post at AIIMS Bilaspur is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection criteria for the Senior Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve preliminary scrutiny of documents, followed by a written test, and finally a personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Senior Project Assistant position at AIIMS Bilaspur is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
